audit_status.source_base: Greek Acts text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for Antioch prophets/teachers, Spirit sending, Cyprus, Elymas, Sergius Paulus, Pisidian Antioch synagogue speech, Davidic promise, resurrection, release/justification, Gentile joy, opposition.

verses.restored: Now there were in Antioch, in the assembly there, prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen foster-brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

familiar.text: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

verses.restored: As they were serving the Lord and fasting, the holy Spirit said, Set apart for me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them.

familiar.text: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.

verses.restored: Then fasting and praying and laying hands on them, they released them.

familiar.text: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

verses.restored: They therefore, being sent out by the holy Spirit, went down to Seleucia, and from there sailed away to Cyprus.

familiar.text: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.

verses.restored: Coming to Salamis, they were announcing the word of the Divine in the synagogues of the Judeans. They also had John as assistant.

familiar.text: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.

verses.restored: Having gone through the whole island as far as Paphos, they found a certain man, a magician, a false prophet, a Judean whose name was Bar-Jesus.

familiar.text: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Barjesus:

verses.restored: He was with the proconsul Sergius Paulus, an intelligent man. This one summoned Barnabas and Saul and sought to hear the word of the Divine.

familiar.text: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.

verses.restored: But Elymas the magician, for thus his name is translated, opposed them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the trust.

familiar.text: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.

verses.restored: Saul, also called Paul, filled with holy Spirit, looked intently at him

familiar.text: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him,

verses.restored: and said, O full of all deceit and all recklessness, son of the adversarial one, enemy of all righteousness/justice, will you not stop twisting the straight ways of the Lord?

familiar.text: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

verses.restored: Now look, the hand of the Lord is upon you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. Immediately mist and darkness fell upon him, and going around, he sought someone to lead him by the hand.

familiar.text: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.

verses.restored: Then the proconsul, seeing what had happened, trusted, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.

familiar.text: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.

verses.restored: Putting out to sea from Paphos, Paul and those around him came to Perga of Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.

familiar.text: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.

verses.restored: They, passing through from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia, and going into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, they sat down.

familiar.text: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.

verses.restored: After the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the synagogue rulers sent to them, saying, Men, siblings, if there is among you a word of encouragement for the people, speak.

familiar.text: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.

verses.restored: Paul stood, motioned with the hand, and said, Men of Israel and those revering the Divine, listen.

familiar.text: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.

verses.restored: The Divine of this people Israel chose our fathers, exalted the people in the sojourn in Egypt, and with uplifted arm led them out from it.

familiar.text: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.

verses.restored: For about forty years he bore with them in the wilderness.

familiar.text: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.

verses.restored: Having destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land as inheritance.

familiar.text: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.

verses.restored: After these things, about four hundred fifty years, he gave judges until Samuel the prophet.

familiar.text: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.

verses.restored: Then they asked for a king, and the Divine gave them Saul son of Kish, a man from the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.

familiar.text: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.

verses.restored: Removing him, he raised up David for them as king, to whom also he bore witness, saying, I found David son of Jesse, a man according to my heart, who will do all my wills.

familiar.text: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.

verses.restored: From this one's seed, according to promise, the Divine brought to Israel a Savior/Healer, Jesus.

familiar.text: Of this man’s seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:

verses.restored: Before his entrance, John had proclaimed a baptism of turning/realignment to all the people of Israel.

familiar.text: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.

verses.restored: As John was completing the course, he said, What do you suppose me to be? I am not he. But look, one comes after me, of whose feet's sandal I am not worthy to loose.

familiar.text: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he. But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.

verses.restored: Men, siblings, sons of Abraham's family and those among you revering the Divine, to us the word of this salvation/healing has been sent.

familiar.text: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.

verses.restored: For those dwelling in Jerusalem and their rulers, not knowing this one nor the voices of the prophets read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by judging him.

familiar.text: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.

verses.restored: Though finding no cause of death, they asked Pilate to have him killed.

familiar.text: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.

verses.restored: When they completed all things written concerning him, taking him down from the tree, they placed him in a tomb.

familiar.text: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.

verses.restored: But the Divine raised him from the dead.

familiar.text: But God raised him from the dead:

verses.restored: He appeared for many days to those who had come up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are now his witnesses to the people.

familiar.text: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.

verses.restored: And we announce good news to you: the promise made to the fathers,

familiar.text: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,

verses.restored: that the Divine has fulfilled this to us, their children, by raising Jesus, as also it is written in the second Psalm: You are my Son; today I have begotten you.

familiar.text: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.

verses.restored: That he raised him from the dead, no longer about to return to decay, he has spoken thus: I will give you the holy and faithful things of David.

familiar.text: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.

verses.restored: Therefore also in another place he says, You will not give your Holy One to see decay.

familiar.text: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

verses.restored: For David, after serving the purpose of the Divine in his own generation, fell asleep and was placed with his fathers and saw decay.

familiar.text: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:

verses.restored: But the one whom the Divine raised did not see decay.

familiar.text: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.

verses.restored: Therefore let it be known to you, men, siblings, that through this one release of sins/misalignments is announced to you.

familiar.text: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:

verses.restored: And from all things from which you were not able to be made righteous/just in the Law of Moses, in this one everyone trusting is made righteous/just.

familiar.text: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.

verses.restored: Therefore watch, lest what has been spoken in the Prophets come upon you:

familiar.text: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;

verses.restored: Look, you despisers, marvel and vanish, because I work a work in your days, a work you would certainly not trust if someone described it to you.

familiar.text: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.

verses.restored: As they were going out, they were urging that these words be spoken to them on the next Sabbath.

familiar.text: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.

verses.restored: When the synagogue gathering was dismissed, many of the Judeans and reverent proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas, who spoke to them and were persuading them to remain in the grace of the Divine.

familiar.text: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.

verses.restored: On the coming Sabbath almost the whole city gathered to hear the word of the Lord.

familiar.text: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.

verses.restored: But the Judeans, seeing the crowds, were filled with jealousy and were contradicting the things spoken by Paul, blaspheming.

familiar.text: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.

verses.restored: Paul and Barnabas spoke boldly and said, It was necessary for the word of the Divine to be spoken first to you. Since you push it away and judge yourselves unworthy of age-long life, look, we turn to the nations.

familiar.text: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.

verses.restored: For so the Lord has commanded us: I have set you as light for nations, that you may be for salvation/healing as far as the end of the earth.

familiar.text: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.

verses.restored: Hearing this, the nations were rejoicing and glorifying the word of the Lord, and as many as were appointed to age-long life trusted.

familiar.text: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.

verses.restored: The word of the Lord was being carried through the whole region.

familiar.text: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.

verses.restored: But the Judeans stirred up the reverent prominent women and the first men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and drove them out from their borders.

familiar.text: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.

verses.restored: They shook off the dust from their feet against them and came into Iconium.

familiar.text: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.

verses.restored: And the disciples were filled with joy and holy Spirit.

familiar.text: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.
